# 4cc Autumn 26

Squad of 23. A player's rating is his best of: dribbling, goalkeeping, finishing, low pass, lofted pass, heading, swerve, catching, clearing, reflexes, coverage, body control, physical contact, kicking power, explosive power, ball control, ball winning, jump, place kicking, stamina, speed, aggression.
May sit below their target: attacking prowess, defensive prowess, injury resistance, weak foot usage, weak foot accuracy.

## Tiers
- **Gold**: 1 per team; every stat 99; form 8, injury resistance 3, weak foot 4/4; 6 paid cards, 3 free tricks; 1 A position.
- **Silver**: 2 per team; every stat 92; form 8, injury resistance 3, weak foot 4/4; 5 paid cards, 3 free tricks; 1 A position.
- **Bronze**: 2 per team; every stat 86; form 8, injury resistance 3, weak foot 4/4; 4 paid cards, 2 free tricks; 1 A position.
- **Goalkeeper**: counts as Regular, registered GK; every stat 77; form 4, injury resistance 1, weak foot 2/2; 2 paid cards; 1 A position.
- **Regular**: the rest of the squad; every stat 77; form 4, injury resistance 1, weak foot 2/2; 3 paid cards, 2 free tricks; 1 A position.

## Heights
Brackets: Manlet up to 175, Mid 180, Tall 185, Giant 194, Giga 199 cm.
- **Green** (when any player is 194 cm or more): 6 manlet, 5 mid, 6 tall, 6 giant, 0 giga.
- **Red** (otherwise): 6 manlet, 7 mid, 10 tall, 0 giant, 0 giga.

## Every team
Every player is rated A at his registered position; starters play only where rated A in preset 1; no B ratings; GK is never a second A; age 15 to 50; weight between height − 129 (at least 30) and height − 81; a captain; at least 1 goalkeeper; at most 10 skill cards.

## Card groups
- **Tricks**: Scissors Feint, Flip Flap, Marseille Turn, Sombrero, Cut Behind & Turn, Scotch Move, Rabona, Double Touch, Crossover Turn, Step on Skill, No Look Pass.

## Special rules
- **Malicia is a free card**: Malicia free.
- **The captain's Captaincy card is free**: The captain: Captaincy free.
- **Medals cannot be goalkeepers**: Gold, Silver or Bronze, registered GK: not allowed ("Medals cannot play as GK").
- **Goalkeepers at 189 count as tall**: Registered GK, 189 cm: count 4 cm shorter.
- **Tall goalkeepers are 189**: Registered GK, 181 to 188 cm: not allowed ("GKs in this bracket must be 189cm").
- **Goalkeepers below giant**: Registered GK, 194 cm or more: not allowed ("GK heights cannot be 194cm or more").
- **Gold below giant**: Gold, 194 cm or more: not allowed ("Gold heights cannot be 194cm or more").
- **Red CBs at 189 count as tall**: Regular, registered CB, under Red, 189 cm: count 4 cm shorter.
- **Manlets**: Manlets: +1 paid card, +1 A position, weak foot 4/4.
- **Red manlet bonus**: Regular, Goalkeeper, Bronze or Silver, under Red, 175 cm or less: may get +2 for Silver, +3 for Bronze, +5 for Goalkeeper, +5 for Regular to every stat.
- **Green silver giants**: Silver, under Green, 194 cm or more: -3 to every stat.
- **Medals trade a free COM style for a free A position**: Gold, Silver or Bronze: gets the first needed of: +1 free COM style; or +1 A position.
- **Gold trades a second free COM style for a free A position**: Gold: gets the first needed of: +1 free COM style; or +1 A position.

## Suggestions
Allowances not used up, listed as suggestions: paid cards, free tricks, free COM styles, weak foot, injury resistance and choices not taken.
